title: The implementer's answer
description: The structured output of a factory:implementer or factory:implementer-light call (incident-platform backlog #0-301, the owner's g1; the light one's text is the implementer's): the same file goes to claude's --json-schema and to dispatcher/src/schema/validate.mjs. Its example is agents/implementer.md's "## Answer (JSON)".

blocked.description: true when the agent stops the item; the owner decides.

reason.description: why it stopped, or null: the agent's words, kept in its answer file, never in a decision of the dispatcher's.

commitMessage.description: The message of the commit the factory makes of this call's changes (#0-302), or null when no file changed: the agent's words. Its form (decision 3 of #0-302, PR #695 of incident-platform): a subject of one line, 1 to 100 characters; then, if there is a body, a blank line and the body, which holds more than blank lines; printable characters and \n alone (no tab, no carriage return, no other control character), at most 8000 in all; and no line that reads as one of the dispatcher's trailers (Factory-…:, Task:, Feature:), which the dispatcher writes itself.
